question: The important system components like the central processing unit (CPU) and random access memory (RAM) modules are connected directly to the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The important system components like the** central processing unit (CPU)** and **random access memory (RAM) **modules are connected directly to the **Motherboard.**
 
• **The motherboard** acts as the** main circuit board** of a **computer system,** providing electrical connections and pathways for various hardware components to communicate with each other.
 
• **The CPU i**s typically inserted into a socket on the motherboard, and the **RAM **modules are installed into slots on the motherboard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnetic Tape:** Magnetic tape is a medium used for long-term storage of data.

 
 
• It is typically used for backup purposes rather than directly connecting components like **CPU and RAM.**
 
• Magnetic tape drives are separate devices that connect to a computer system.
 
 
 
• **Optical Disk: **An optical disk is a storage medium that uses laser technology to read and write data.
 
 
• Examples of optical disks include **CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray discs**.
 
• While optical drives can be connected to the motherboard, they are used primarily for reading and writing data from optical disks rather than directly connecting the** CPU and RAM.**
 
 
 
• **Flash memory** is a type of **non-volatile memory** that retains data even when power is removed.
 
 
• It is commonly used in **USB flash drives**, **solid-state drives (SSDs),** and **memory cards.**
 
• **Flash memory **can be connected to the **motherboard** through various interfaces such as** USB, SATA, or PCIe**.
